in_marathi.name: Chanak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘चाणक’ (Chaṇak), meaning 'strong' or 'firm'. In Hindu mythology, Chanak is the name of a demon king, known for his immense strength and power.
